peers.name: Apple Inc.
peers.rationale: Mega-cap tech competitor with overlapping devices, services, and platform ecosystem strategy, though hardware mix differs materially from Microsoft's enterprise/cloud weighting.

peers.name: Alphabet Inc.
peers.rationale: Direct competitor in cloud infrastructure (Google Cloud vs Azure), productivity software, and AI investment, with comparable scale and diversified revenue base.

peers.name: AMAZON COM INC
peers.rationale: AWS is the leading cloud infrastructure competitor to Azure; retail segment is not comparable, so fit is partial but cloud economics overlap strongly.

peers.name: ORACLE CORP
peers.rationale: Enterprise software and database vendor increasingly competing in cloud infrastructure and applications, similar enterprise customer base though smaller scale.

peers.name: Salesforce, Inc.
peers.rationale: Enterprise SaaS competitor overlapping with Microsoft's Dynamics and productivity cloud offerings, similar subscription-based enterprise software economics.

peers.name: SAP SE
peers.rationale: Global enterprise applications leader competing with Microsoft's business software suite, similar large enterprise customer focus and subscription transition.

peers.name: INTERNATIONAL BUSINESS MACHINES CORP
peers.rationale: Enterprise IT, hybrid cloud, and AI competitor with overlapping enterprise services, though IBM's mix skews more toward consulting and legacy hardware.

peers.name: ADOBE INC.
peers.rationale: Software subscription model comparable to Microsoft 365, overlapping creative and productivity software markets though smaller and more narrowly focused.
